external_research_delta.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere (2025), How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, arXiv:2505.20896
external_research_delta.finding: Training can move from random behavior through shallow heuristics to systematic variable dereferencing; causal interventions localize an emergent routing mechanism in residual-stream/attention computation.
external_research_delta.training_implication: Do not infer dynamic binding from balanced accuracy alone. Preserve full mapping permutations, OOD transfer and causal/mechanistic tests where available; explicitly test for shortcut-phase behavior.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training/evaluating Xeno on explicit original observation identity plus a typed revalidation/rebase action will reduce stale-result assimilation more reliably than generic textual warnings about staleness.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A deterministic runtime gate alone may solve stale admission, while model-side protocol training adds lexical overfitting without improving generalization.
hypotheses.discriminator: Family-disjoint matched eval comparing generic stale warnings versus explicit epoch+digest+generation+observation-id/rebase traces, with deterministic gate held constant.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A separate epistemic/metrology evaluation family teaching that ten outputs or ten historical PIDs do not prove ten simultaneous processes will reduce scope inflation without polluting core cognitive-process SFT.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The distinction is purely deterministic runtime evidence and should never be trained into the model target channel.
hypotheses.discriminator: Keep as non-trainable hard-negative eval first; promote only if the candidate checkpoint repeatedly overclaims physical/runtime scope under exact evidence-minimal pairs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model-visible semantic ablation plus full S3 permutation-orbit checks will detect binding shortcuts that metadata-only balance/MI audits miss.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Exact prompt-level ablation can itself create unnatural artifacts and underestimate hidden nuisance shortcuts that survive serialization/tokenization.
hypotheses.discriminator: Run both exact rendered-byte ablation and independent shallow challengers on frozen family-disjoint splits; require agreement before any binding-family admission.
